Commentary.Commentary: Bairstow and Ali tried their best but it was always going to be tough. The wicketkeeper hit another fifty before Riaz got his crucial wicket. The final stand frustrated Pakistan a bit but in the end, England could only post 253 on the board and now PAKISTAN NEED 40 RUNS TO WIN! Join us back in a bit for Pakistan's reply as they look to draw the series 2-2!

Remarkable bowling by Pakistan! Although they would have liked an innings win here. Their bowlers bowled their hearts out and England only managed 253 runs. Yasir Shah was the tormenter-in-chief as the leggie grabbed another 5-wicket haul. Wahab Riaz finished with two wickets before he was removed from the attack for landing on the danger area.

There is a loud appeal from the Pakistanis and the umpire obliges and gives it out. Anderson can't review it as they do not have any review left. The replays and hawk eye show that the ball would have kissed the top of the stumps.

Iftikhar Ahmed into the attack!
FOUR! Shortish on off, it's a googly, Finn smacks it down the ground towards long on for a boundary to end the over. This should be frustrating for Pakistan.
Outside off, Anderson plays it past point for a single.
FOUR BYES! Bowls it down the leg side, Anderson leaves it alone. The ball runs to the fine leg fence for four byes.
Appeal for an LBW! Outside off, turning in, Anderson looks to play it across but misses and gets hit on the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal as impact was outside off.

Landed outside off, Anderson tries to push but gets an outside edge towards gully.

Pakistan are sensing victory and will be motivated to come back after Lunch and put in their best efforts. England still trail by 20 runs with only 4 wickets in hand. Will the duo of Jonny Bairstow and Chris Woakes stand in their way and pave a way for England to come back in the match or will the tourists run through the lower middle of the home side and seal the match? Join us for the post lunch session which promises to be an enticing one!

England showed good composure in the first session and played positive cricket. Unfortunately they lost Moeen Ali just at the stroke of lunch when they were running away with this session. This evens out the session and Pakistan still hold a firm grip on the match. Gary Ballance played a loose shot and gifted his wicket away to Sohail Khan. Yasir Shah bowled good lines and lengths and finally got the prized wicket of Moeen Ali who was playing beautifully and was threatening to take the game away.

Can the pair of Gary Ballance and Jonny Bairstow put in heroic performances and bail England out of trouble or will the tourists stamp their authority on the final Test and give themselves an opportunity to clinch the No. 1 Test Ranking? Join us for the fourth day of the final Test which promises to be a captivating one!

With two days still left in the final Test, Pakistan are well and truly in the driver's seat and are marching along towards a victory. England are still not out of it but it will be an uphill task for them to tame the inspired Pakistani bowlers. Wahab and Amir are bending their backs and look threatening and Yasir Shah is bowling with sheer authority and has hit a beautiful rhythm with his leg spinners, googlies and sliders.
...Day 4, Session 1...

Another good day of Test cricket and with two days left, Pakistan hold all the aces. England are still not out of this although the task ahead is certainly very difficult. Do tune in tomorrow at 1530 IST for the fourth day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

Earlier in the day, Younis Khan's double ton stole the limelight as the veteran put up a masterclass display to put Pakistan in the driver's seat. The legend farmed the strike brilliantly with the tail to ensure the lead crossed 200 for the visitors. England's bowlers weren't quite accurate enough on a consistent basis on a track that did have a little something for the bowlers. The batsmen were able to get runs but it certainly wasn't a placid track by any means. The hosts still trail by 126 runs with 6 wickets left in the tank.

Yet another great session for Pakistan as they nipped out four England scalps. After Lord's, Yasir Shah hadn't quite set the series on fire but he surely did in the final session today with a triple strike. Wahab's ripper derailed Cook to give the tourists the perfect start after the tea break before Yasir took over. The leggie removed Hales and Vince quickly before nailing the big fish Root in a wily spell of leg spin bowling. Bairstow and Ballance managed to prevent further damage although the latter was lucky to survive a close lbw shout against Yasir.
Darted around off, Gary defends stoutly. Despite the keenness of the Pakistani bowlers to slip in another over, the Umpire calls it STUMPS ON DAY 3 and flicks off the bails!
Fired in full just outside off, Ballance prods forward in defence.
Gary has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Quick through the air, Gary pushes it to the covers.
Arm ball, zipped in from back of a length. Gary defends it solidly.
Full toss just outside off,  Gary punches it firmly and hits short leg on the shin.
Tossed up around off, pushed to short extra cover.
Slips in a googly, Bairstow gets an inside edge on to his pads.
Slower through the air, but Bairstow reaches out to it and blocks.
Sliding on towards middle, defended solidly again.
Drifting in towards middle, defended solidly by Bairstow.
Bairstow clips it to mid-wicket.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Gary defends it solidly.
A bit short. Gary goes back quickly and defends it.
Sliding in from round the wicket, Gary is solid in his defence.
Tossed up on middle and off, Bairstow clips it to long on for a single.
IFTIKHAR AHMED COMES INTO THE ATTACK!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery and the batsmen come through for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Bairstow cover drives it nicely and it goes past the diving fielder at cover point and reaches the fence!
A bit quicker around off, defended back down the pitch.
Bairstow uses his reach again to tackle the spin and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Bairstow lunges in defence.
Flatter and sliding in from outside off, Bairstow punches it off his back foot.
Back of a length just outside off, Gary pushes it towards covers.
3 runs! That's a good shot! Fullish around off, Bairstow leans into the drive and times it sweetly down the ground. Wahab gives a good chase and dives to keep the ball in play. He saved a run there.
FOUR! On a length around off, Bairstow waits for it and guides it through the gully region and the ball races to the boundary!
Fullish ball angled in. Bairstow is compact in his defence.
On a similar channel, Bairstow goes through the motion again and leaves it.
On a length outside off, Bairstow leaves that one.
Tossed up outside off, Gary pushes it towards the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated up, Bairstow lunges forward and pushes it to covers for a single.

OUT! YASIR YOU BEAUTY! Slider around middle and leg. Pitches and skids on and Root is caught on the crease. He tries to flick it late but misses and the ball thuds low on to his pads. He seemed plumb in front to the naked eye but Root takes a review. The ball tracker and Hawk eye confirm that and the ball would have crashed into the middle stump. England are in deep trouble now!
Root has been given out lbw. He opts for the review.
Tossed up, Root lunges forward and defends it confidently.
Slider on the stumps! Root defends it tentatively from his back foot.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! On a length outside off. Root takes a couple of steps down the wicket and gets a thick edge which dies in front of Younis Khan at covers and races to the boundary.
Pitched up outside off, Root mistimes his drive to the covers.
Pacy ball from round the stump, straightens after pitching. Root plays at that one and is beaten comprehensively!
On a length, Root defends it off his back foot.
JOE ROOT REACHES 4000 RUNS IN TEST CRICKET.
Back of a length outside off, Root punches it through point for a couple.
Flatter on a length, turns sharply. Gary tries to tuck it down the corner but misses and is struck high on the pads.
Tossed up from round the stumps, Gary defends it solidly.
Lunges out to smother the leg-break.
Flighted ball, pushed through the covers for a single.
Tossed up, Root plays it to point.
Around off, drifting in. Defended from the back foot.
Fullish delivery, angling in from wide of the crease. Gary prods in defence and blocks it.
On a length around off, Gary tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Almost an action replay of the previous delivery. Gary ducks under it.
Bouncer! Dug in short and zips off the pitch. Ballance takes evasive action and duck under it.
Fuller and closer to off, Root steers it through point for a single.
On a length outside off, angling away. Root pokes at that one and gets beaten.
Drifting in from just outside off, chopped to short mid-wicket.
Floats it up outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked from the crease.
Flatter outside off, worked off the back foot to backward square leg for a single.

Four Leg byes! NOT OUT! Floats up the leg break very full outside off, spins in sharply as Ballance misses the sweep. The ball goes off the pads to the fine leg fence. Huge lbw appeal but not given. Misbah goes for the review. No inside edge involved as confirmed by Hot Spot and Snicko. Impact is umpire's call and that settles the case. It would have hit the stumps but impact comes first and so Ballance survives. A very close call for the batsman and the decision stays.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid off.
Pitched up around off, Ballance leans forward and pushes it nicely through mid off to the deep. Three runs to the total.
Fuller and just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Dug in short but once again well down the leg side, another easy leave for Gary.
Good length speared well down the leg side, left alone to the keeper.
Back of a length just outside off, angled away, steered towards backward point for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on.
Tossed up well outside off, Ballance gets a long stride in and defends.
Drifting in on a length from outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
GARY BALLANCE is the new man in.

OUT! GOT HIM! Yasir has another and England in some trouble now. Floated up outside off, lures Vince into the drive and he can't keep the shot down. Misbah at short cover gobbles up the chance. England still trail by 159 runs. Pakistan on the rampage.
Ripper from Yasir! Floats it up around off, came in with the angle and spun away sharply to beat the outside edge. It was very close to the off pole as well.
Flighted around off, defended well off the front foot down the track.
Flatter and a touch short outside off, pulled towards wide mid on for a single.
Good length around off, whipped away through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Root jams it towards the covers.
Good length outside off, shaping away as Root lets it pass.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Short ball around off, Root rocks back nicely and pulls it away beautifully to the deep mid-wicket fence. Root's happy playing his shots.
Length ball outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Good length angled in from outside off, Root gets back and blocks it out.
JAMES VINCE is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLING CHANGE WORKS! Floats it up just around off, the wrong 'un from Yasir and Hales misses the block to be rapped on the pads. Appeal for lbw and it's given by the umpire. Alex opts for the review almost quickly. Has he hit it? It's a legal ball and there is no inside edge as confirmed by both Hot Spot and Snicko. Ball Tracker shows the impact in line and hitting middle stump. The original decision stays and Pakistan are elated. Waste of a review really as it looked plumb unless there was an inside edge.
Hales has been given out lbw. He opts for the review.
Loopy on a length on off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Floats it up on off, blocked well off the front foot.
Drifting in on a length around off, pushed off the back foot to the bowler.
Another half-tracker wide outside off, crunched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! CRASHED! Starts with a long hop outside off, asking to be hit and Root hammers the pull past mid-wicket to find the fence.
Time for some leg spin then. YASIR SHAH comes on to bowl.
Good length well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Shortish just outside off, Hales goes back and pushes it to cover-point.
Slightly short of a good length outside off, tapped towards backward point for a single.
Fuller and around off, Root gets across and bunts it past the bowler towards mid on.
Length ball too far outside off, easy leave for Root.
Shortish on middle and off, tucked off the back foot through backward square leg for a couple.
Dug in short on off, Hales quickly ducks under the bumper.
Good length angled in from around off, defended from the crease by Alex.
FOUR! Creamed! Fuller and outside off, width on offer and Hales obliges with a firm push through the covers. Timed it really well.
Shortish outside off, comfortably left alone by Hales.
Back of a length outside off, angling in, Hales lets it pass.
Short and outside off, pushed off the back foot to deep point for a single.
Drinks break....
Pitched up in the corridor outside off, good accurate stuff from Sohail and Hales is doing well to leave these.
Full and tailing in from off, Hales gets across and digs it out to cover.
Full and just around off, good leave from Hales.
Back of a length outside off, Hales hangs back and taps it towards short cover.
Full and around off, nicely blocked off the front foot by Hales.
Fuller on middle and off, Root works it down to long leg for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Hales camps back and blocks it.
Wahab has been officially warned for running on the danger area of the pitch.
Good length outside off, Hales blocks it off the back foot.
Another back of a length ball on off, Hales gets back and across to block it.
Good length on off, blocked well from the crease. Hales blocks it from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, Hales lets it pass.
Shortish outside off, Hales goes back on his toes and taps it towards gully.
No ball! And again! Wahab oversteps once more. Back of a length outside off, Hales plays inside the line of that one.
No ball! Back of a length angled away outside off, left alone to the keeper. Wahab has overstepped again.
Full and just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, nicely driven off the front foot towards mid off.
Good length outside off, Root continues to make another leave.
Length ball outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Back of a length well outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a brace. Good sliding stop near the ropes by the fielder.
FOUR! SHOT! Short and wide outside off, Root rocks back and slaps it through point to find the fence. Loosener to start from Sohail.
SOHAIL KHAN is back on.
On a length outside off and Hales knows it is not going to come back from such an angle and leaves it easily.
Angling away from a good length outside off, Hales lets it go through to the keeper. Riaz is bending his back and generating good pace.
Back of a length ball, Hales stands tall in his crease and defends it into the ground.
Wide outside off, Riaz hits the pitch hard. Hales leaves it alone.
Root dabs that one into the covers and comes through for a sharp single.
Short of a length delivery, climbing up on Root. Root goes back and angles it to gully.
Outside off, Hales leaves it alone.
On a length outside off, Hales plays at it tentatively and the ball fizzes through to the keeper at quite a distance from his bat.
On a good length outside off and sliding away, Hales is watchful and lets it go.
Too full outside off, Root dabs it away through the covers for a single.
Good inswinger on middle. Root clips it away nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fullish delivery, Root pushes it gently through the covers for a couple!
Good length ball outside off, angling away. Hales steers it through the gully region for a couple!
FOUR BYES! Bouncer! That's too short. It keeps climbing steeply and flies well over the jumping Sarfaraz and races to the boundary.
Shortish on leg stump, Root misses the ball on the flick and it runs down to fine leg from his thigh pad for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
JOE ROOT is the new man in.

OUT! RIAZ STRIKES WITH A SCREAMER! Back of a  length ball around off, 90 MPH! Riaz gets extra bounce on that one. Cook pokes at it hesitantly and gets a thick outside edge which carries to Iftikhar Ahmed at first slip at a comfortable height and he pouches it safely! That's the first blow for England!
Length ball, nipping in. Cook pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! Back of a length wide outside off, Cook cuts it beautifully through covers and the ball races to the boundary! Riaz has also overstepped and that's a No Ball!
WAHAB RIAZ INTO THE ATTACK FOR THE FIRST TIME!
Short delivery on leg, Cook pulls it well and behind square leg for a single.
Full and swinging away from off, Cook prods forward in defence.
That's a beautiful outswinger! Cook is forced to play at it and gets beaten all ends up.
Fullish ball swinging away, draws Cook into the drive and he gets a thick outside edge which falls short of the first slip. Good bowling from Amir!
Overpitched on middle, Cook drives it firmly to mid on.
On a length sneaked in from wide of the crease, nips in a bit. Cook is alert to that one and blocks it. He is not a natural inswinger.
On a length wide outside off, Hales lets it go through. That's a maiden over by Sohail!
Wide outside off, Hales leaves it alone.
Full and swinging away outside off, Hales dabs it towards the cover region.
Pitched up at the stumps, Hales pushes it to mid on.
Hales stands tall in the crease and blocks it to mid-wicket.
On a length around off, swinging in. Hales jumps a bit and gets an inside edge on to his pads. There is a half hearted appeal from the Pakistanis and the Umpire is unmoved.
Back of a length outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
On a length, comes back a bit this time. Cook defends it solidly.
Fullish ball, Cook pushes it to mid off.
That's a beauty from Amir! On a good length around off, swinging away. Cook looks to defend it at first but decides against it and withdraws just at the nick of time.
On a good length outside off, swinging away. Cook leaves it alone.
Fullish delivery just around off, Cook is compact in his defence.
On a good length outside off, swinging away. Hales does not flirt with that one.
Bouncer and it is pretty well directed! Hales ducks under it and evades it well.
Fullish ball outside off, inviting Hales into the drive and he obliges and pushes it sweetly through the covers for a couple.
Length ball on middle, Hales defends it towards mid on.
Down the leg side, Hales leaves it alone.
Fullish around middle and leg, Hales goes for the flick but gets an inside edge on to his pads. The English players appeal but in vain!
On a length outside off, not close enough to draw Cook into a shot!
Outswinger outside off. Cook is not tempted to play at that one.
Fullish delivery on leg, Cook tries to flick it away but instead gets a leading edge and it rolls on safely down the pitch.
Good length outside off. Cook lets that one go through.
Full delivery wide outside off, swinging away, Cook has nothing to do with it.
Fullish around off, swinging away. Cook prods forward and is solid in his defence.
Good length ball curling away outside off, Hales leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, Hales watches it carefully and leaves it alone.
On the pads, Cook flicks it through square leg for a single.
Swinging in on middle. Cook defends it nicely!
Some inswing on middle and off, Cook tucks it to square leg.
Back of a length around off, Cook defends it with authority.
FOUR! Too straight and straying into the pads. Hales flicks it easily through mid-wicket and the ball races to the boundary!
Full length and angling across Hales. Hales is drawn into the drive and gets beaten. Great delivery from Amir!
Tigther line, this one holds its line. Cook blocks it hesitantly towards mid off for a single.
Good swing on offer. Full outside off, Cook leaves it comfortably.
Short of length, Cook steers it too point.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Cook.
Around off, Hales covers the line well and defends it.
On a length around off, shaping away. Hales pokes at it and it flies off his outside edge and falls just short of the man at third slip. Lovely shape from Sohail!
That's a great delivery! On a good length, nipping away. Hales plays at the one but gets beaten comprehensively.
Back of a length straightening on off, Hales defends it off his front foot.
Back of a length outside off, Hales lets it go. Couple of gentle looseners to start with!
Half-volley outside off, Hales restricts himself and blocks it into the ground.
SOHAIl KHAN TO BOWL FROM THE OTHER END!
Back of a length outside off, Cook does not flirt with that one.
That's a sensational delivery! Good length delivery around off, swinging away. Cook has no choice but to play at it and is beaten all ends up.
Full and wide, Cook is not interested and leaves it alone.
In a similar channel, Cook is watchful and shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Fullish outside off, curling away a bit. Cook lets it go through.
On a length outside off, swings in a bit. Cook goes back and defends it solidly. Good ball to begin with!
